intro: Lok's Skull is the severed head of Lok Orcbane, a fierce Razormane warrior who led brutal quilboar raids against Horde supply routes in the southern Barrens. Sought after by the imprisoned quilboar Mangletooth as an act of vengeance, the skull serves as undeniable proof that the raiders' chieftain has fallen.

p: Emerging from Razorfen Kraul into the southern Barrens, Lok Orcbane spearheaded aggressive Razormane quilboar assaults on Horde supply lines alongside his lieutenants Nak and Kuz. After betraying and abandoning Mangletooth to captivity in Camp Taurajo, Lok earned a grim reputation among orcish defenders who struggled to contain his ruthless raids. Claiming Lok's skull not only avenges the wronged captive who directs Horde champions to Lok's camp, but also shatters the core leadership driving the Razormane offensive.
